CustomObject.label: Event Attendee
CustomObject.description: The people an imported list is about. R5 makes this the only thing Screen 1 writes: an attendee is a person we have on a list, held on our own object, created without reference to any Account, Contact or Lead. One row per person, reused across every event — the link to an event is Event_Invitee__c, so inviting the same person to three events is three invitee rows against one attendee. ★R8 An attendee may afterwards be linked to a Contact via Contact__c, but only by a reconciliation run: the import still creates them knowing nothing about the org's own data, which is what keeps it safe to run against a populated org.
